# Streaming audio resampler attribution

The standalone Resampler in beat-this-audio.js is retained from this application's
former BeatNet browser integration (Mojtaba Heydari, Frank Cwitkowitz, Zhiyao Duan).
Source: https://github.com/mjhydri/BeatNet
CC BY 4.0: LICENSE.txt. Adaptation: browser streaming windowed-sinc resampling.
Only this audio utility remains; no BeatNet model, CRNN, or particle tracker is used.
